abstract: We attempt to build 10 open-source AI agent repositories into containers at pinned commits and to start each resulting image in a network-denied sandbox. 6 build successfully and 6 pass a container environment check, a rate of 60.0 percent. We report the distribution of failure causes and, for each, whether the cause is a property of the agent or a limit of the harness. We do not measure whether any agent runs.
title: Container viability of open-source AI agents
